title: Lane lint gives a verdict inside the cloud's command time limit
why: `merge --lane-lint 1458` hit the 590 s command time limit twice in a cloud session with no verdict (lane notes-fix-large-1, 06:57 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: lane lint on #1458's head prints a verdict in a cloud session, or it runs in the background and a later call reads its verdict. Measure each step's time first. Watch step lane-lint-hook-suites (#1916), which adds suites. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Title by triage. Doing in lane session_013NEJL1PUcS4Dxhd9Rr1sk2 (07:02 CST Nov 8); it measures each lane-lint step's time on #1458's head first. Governing ruling: decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job, owner's words (2026-10-27, page item 27 a): a lane runs only the suites its change touches, and never a whole CI job. The sentence 'It runs no hook suite and no mutation test' landed later (batch 23, #840, 2026-10-29) as a tool description, not the owner's words; #1844, #1916 and #2001 rewrite it to 'picked suites only', which fits the ruling. So lane lint runs only the suites the change picks; the 52 lint fixture suites (513.6 s of 586.2 s on #1458's head, n=1, 4 CPUs) run only when picked. Page item 422 was withdrawn on that ruling (07:39 CST; reply corrected 07:43 CST Nov 8). Lane conflict answered from the ruling, nothing filed (07:43 CST Nov 8). Built as #2017, at review round 2 (lane, 09:12 CST Nov 8). Ready 10:25 CST Nov 8: #2017 handed to runner 8 (lane lint PASS on de1c0e755, rounds 1-3, net value positive). Done when #2017 merges. Sighting (lane compare-files-missing-key, #1616, via the coordinator 04:45 CST Nov 9): a background time limit shorter than lane lint's run killed one run. Measured: lane lint took 744 to 856 s on 3 runs on Nov 9. Incidents 01:53 CST Nov 10 (coordinator, from lane reports, not timed): lane lint ended UNKNOWN at the 1200 s cap on #2452, #2413 (twice), #2366 (twice) and #2200 (twice), on 4-CPU cloud boxes; passes ran 1002-1143 s (#2488 1092, #2465 1002, #2462 1061, #2463 1056, #2489 1143, #2500 1071), so main's lint sits near the cap. Measure 01:57 CST Nov 10 (coordinator, lane #2385): ci-job listed 15 steps when #2385's earlier head passed in 614.6 s; it now lists 27 (new: Python 3.9 floor, Agent push form, Retired names) and hit the 1200 s cap twice at load about 1.0. Alone, lint/test_check_python_floor.py took 77.5 s; lint/test_agent_push_form.py 0.1 s. Measure 02:04 CST Nov 10 (coordinator, #2200): the lane lint stopped at the cap three times, the last alone in the container at load 0.7, each time near the 27th step (STE lint and the STE lint action fixture suite). Points at one slow step, not load. Sighting 02:12 CST Nov 10 (lane 854, #2379 head eb8defaba): lane lint ran the full 1200 s twice and read unknown; its log showed the 'Python 3.9 floor fixture suite' failed (132 failures, 2 errors), each a FileNotFoundError for lint/check_python_floor.py and .github/workflows/checks.yml in the lint worktree, though both are on main and the head. The coordinator's lint of the same head passed (1026 s). Why the tree lacked the files is unmeasured (disk pressure or a half-built tree are guesses). A missing tree file could fail fast instead of running to the cap. Lane code-check-cost-pins started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
